scope: Planted footwork, pivots, weight transfer and connected defense stage

results.full_runtime: 55/55 jobs; 24 bosses at 454/454 and determinism at 57/57

checks: Native forward, retreat, left and right with reversals and settling for four stance presets.
Native circling, rope and corner clamping while guarding.
Slip left/right, duck, weave and lean carry the pelvis and return into guard/movement.
Movement into defense and rapid reversals replay identically at 30/60/144 Hz; rendering does not mutate combat.
Fixed bone lengths and attached mesh endpoints at interpolated poses; actual forefoot reconstructed from rendered ankle and pivot.
Body aim lies on crouching torso; visible head stays clear of torso; authoritative head coordinates retained.
All ten punch families, contact/recovery, native cancellation/interrupts and hitstop pass the existing motion gates.

design_reconciliation.body_aim: Standing 1.10 height now follows existing downward head compression. Body eligibility has no vertical test, so every hit/miss rule is unchanged. This removes the deep-duck head/torso overlap.
design_reconciliation.edge_fixture: An IDLE boss still approaches; the native edge fixture now holds its empty ACTING queue and retains the original >140 degree edge extension check.
design_reconciliation.delivery_repair: Rising punches sweep in front of the advancing shoulder, with clearance released before exact contact. This repairs a wrist-near-shoulder IK singularity exposed by weight transfer.

render_review.observations: Inspected reversal support, circling guard, lowered duck, rearward lean, consecutive hookercut frames and native chase step-in. Foot plants and fixed limb connections remain coherent; duck head is clear of torso.
render_review.boundary: These are procedural rig inspection scenes. Some HUD feedback persists between synthetic fixtures; these frames are not a fresh-player usability session.

limitations: Stage completion is not professional boxing authenticity, player fun, physical input latency, final character art or full ecosystem acceptance.
PAC-202D combinations, PAC-202E authored style/build expression, PAC-202F integrated readiness and PAC-203/PAC-204 remain scheduled.
Existing Windows root-certificate diagnostic and ObjectDB exit warnings are retained in raw logs; no leak-free claim.
raw_evidence: .PACER/PAC-202C (earlier failed attempts and all 145 rendered frames retained locally)
